kind: driver fixed cost measured on the walking-skeleton STUB accelerator (T1.0)
note: The stub returns DONE one cycle after START and fetches no descriptor, so drv_chain (= median chain window minus the empty rdcycle-pair window) is the pure driver cost of one mcuaccel_run call including its call-site; with the real accelerator the CPU polls while it runs and only the exit phase of the poll loop is added. drv_patch = (p5 - p1)/4 cycles per patched descriptor field; patch_slope_lsq is the least-squares slope over 1, 2 and 5 fields. Codegen is the compiler's: the call site hoisted &ad into a register (mv, 1 ALU) where a straight-line model_run needs lui+addi (2 ALU), and fields beyond the second need a lui+addi address each.

cpi_estimate.source: model/m1.py CPI table (DESIGN 9.5), the pre-measurement estimate

poll_loop_string: lw a5,0(a3); andi a4,a5,1; bne a4,zero,800005c4 <mcuaccel_run+0x18>
compiler: riscv-none-elf-gcc (xPack GNU RISC-V Embedded GCC arm64) 15.2.0
